headline: Cold-start cost is one 9.68s teacher call whose patch is never consumed; JEV re-escalates map_topology every cycle although /world/map/0 facts are retrieved every cycle.

stage_harness.note: cold-vs-warm mechanics+imports differ <1s; the 14.4s gap is LLM latency
